text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of a previous cesarean section and the onset of severe pain with bleeding, I am concerned about uterine rupture. I will immediately request a fetal heart rate monitor and an abdominal exam to assess for signs of abdominal tenderness or a change in fetal lie.
